plumbing.review:
No repair findings. The only production change adds unconditional `--init` to the shared launch, preserving other settings (`repo/internal/plumbing/sandbox.go:197`). The acceptance source matches the ratified plan: it checks launch arguments and, when enabled, verifies adoption by PID 1 and disappearance after SIGKILL (`repo/internal/plumbing/sandbox_init_accept_test.go:93`, `:193`).

Scope, documentation citations, and surrounding style are preserved. No weakened checks, test special-casing, added sandbox access, or secret leakage found. Factory formatting, vet, package tests, and acceptance checks passed (`tests.txt:1`).

**Merger work**

- Record the `--init` decision and cite it in both sandbox documents (`repo/README.md:89`, `repo/SPEC.md:184`).
- Run the Docker-dependent orphan check documented at `repo/README.md:87`: `INVARIANT_PLUMBING_INIT_REAL=1 go test ./internal/plumbing -run '^TestSandboxReapsOrphanedProcesses$' -count=1 -timeout 20m`.
- Run the real-image budget check on a cgroup-v2 Docker host (`repo/README.md:85`): `INVARIANT_PLUMBING_REAL=1 go test ./internal/plumbing -run '^TestSandboxBudgetAndRealCheckout$' -count=1 -timeout 45m`.

VERDICT: approve
